' SOLAR - a 3D vector space shooter in a small solar system, for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC
' BASIC (VB5 flavour)
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Pirates have come to the Kestrel system: a yellow sun, four planets going round it, a ring of
' rocks. Fly your fighter among them and shoot the pirates down, wave after wave. Don't fly into
' the sun or a planet, and keep inside the system.
'
' Wireframe 3D as the CITY3D demo draws it: View.cls does the sums (camera, projection, models,
' cut at the camera - all Z80), L2.cls draws on Layer 2 with two buffers. The panels, the bars
' and the scanner are the tilemap; the sights and the scanner's blips are hardware sprites; the
' sound is the AY.
'
' Keys: Q / A pitch (nose down / up), O / P turn left / right, Z / X roll, Space fire,
'       M faster, N slower. Kempston joystick: pitch and turn, fire.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const NE = 5, NB = 5, NSTAR = 12, NR = 4
Const WORLD = 8500
' colours (Layer 2: RRRGGGBB)
Const C_SUN = &HFC, C_SUN2 = &HF0, C_LASER = &HE0
Const C_STAR = &HB6

' the sun (0) and the planets (1-4): radius, orbit, angle, speed (256ths a turn x 64), colour
Dim br(4) As Integer, bo(4) As Integer, ba(4) As Integer, bsp(4) As Integer, bc(4) As Integer
Dim bx(4) As Integer, by(4) As Integer, bz(4) As Integer
' rocks: positions (fixed), their basis (all share one), kind
Dim rpos(17) As Integer, rbas(8) As Integer
' pirates: position (x, y, z) and basis (9) each
Dim epos(14) As Integer, ebas(44) As Integer
Dim eon(4) As Integer, ehp(4) As Integer, ek(4) As Integer, ecool(4) As Integer, eturn(4) As Integer, espd(4) As Integer
' stars: directions
Dim sdx(15) As Integer, sdy(15) As Integer, sdz(15) As Integer
' 2D sparks
Dim pl(31) As Integer, ppx(31) As Integer, ppy(31) As Integer, pvx(31) As Integer, pvy(31) As Integer
Dim pnext As Integer
Dim tbas(8) As Integer                  ' the title's ship
Dim speed As Integer, shield As Integer, heat As Integer, cool As Integer, firing As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long
Dim wave As Integer, left1 As Integer, over As Integer, waveT As Integer, dead As Integer, lives As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, seed As Integer, firewas As Integer, warn As Integer, warnWas As Integer
Dim hudT As Integer, i As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
L2.Init 0
View.Init
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSLU
Setup
hiscore = 5000
Do
  Title
  Play
  GameOver
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the system
Sub Setup()
  Dim k As Integer
  br(0) = 900 : bo(0) = 0 : bc(0) = C_SUN
  br(1) = 220 : bo(1) = 2400 : bsp(1) = 90 : bc(1) = &H9B          ' a rock world
  br(2) = 380 : bo(2) = 4000 : bsp(2) = 60 : bc(2) = &H1F          ' an ocean world
  br(3) = 520 : bo(3) = 6000 : bsp(3) = 40 : bc(3) = &HF4          ' a ringed giant
  br(4) = 260 : bo(4) = 7600 : bsp(4) = 30 : bc(4) = &H5D          ' an ice world
  For k = 1 To 4
    ba(k) = k * 64 * 64 + 1000
  Next
  For k = 0 To 8
    rbas(k) = 0
  Next
  rbas(0) = 16384 : rbas(4) = 16384 : rbas(8) = 16384
  tbas(0) = 16384 : tbas(4) = 16384 : tbas(8) = 16384
End Sub

' the planets a step on round their orbits (the sun stays put)
Sub Orbits()
  Dim k As Integer, a As Integer
  bx(0) = 0 : by(0) = 0 : bz(0) = 0
  For k = 1 To 4
    ba(k) = ba(k) + bsp(k)
    a = (ba(k) \ 64) And 255
    bx(k) = View.FMul(bo(k), Models.Sine((a + 64) And 255))
    bz(k) = View.FMul(bo(k), Models.Sine(a))
    by(k) = bx(k) \ 8
  Next
End Sub

Sub NewStars()
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To NSTAR - 1
    sdx(k) = Rnd(16001) - 8000 : sdy(k) = Rnd(16001) - 8000 : sdz(k) = Rnd(16001) - 8000
  Next
End Sub

' the rocks: a ring between the ocean world and the giant
Sub Rocks()
  Dim k As Integer, a As Integer
  For k = 0 To NR - 1
    a = k * 64 + Rnd(30)
    rpos(k * 3) = CLng(5000) * Models.Sine((a + 64) And 255) \ 16384
    rpos(k * 3 + 1) = Rnd(600) - 300
    rpos(k * 3 + 2) = CLng(5000) * Models.Sine(a) \ 16384
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- input
Function FirePressed() As Integer
  Dim f As Integer
  f = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
  FirePressed = f And Not firewas
  firewas = f
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the panels
Sub Panels()
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer
  Tiles.Fill GfxData.T_BLACK
  ' the scanner: cells 12-27, rows 28-31
  For y = 28 To 31
    For x = 12 To 27
      If y = 28 Then
        Tiles.Put x, y, GfxData.T_SCANT
      ElseIf y = 31 Then
        Tiles.Put x, y, GfxData.T_SCANB
      ElseIf y = 30 Then
        Tiles.Put x, y, GfxData.T_SCANC
      Else
        Tiles.Put x, y, GfxData.T_SCAN
      End If
    Next
  Next
  Tiles.Rect 11, 28, 1, 4, GfxData.T_SCANL
  Tiles.Rect 28, 28, 1, 4, GfxData.T_SCANR
  Tiles.Rect 0, 28, 11, 4, GfxData.T_PANEL
  Tiles.Rect 29, 28, 11, 4, GfxData.T_PANEL
  Tiles.Text 1, 1, "SHIELD"
  Tiles.Text 15, 1, "LASER"
  Tiles.Text 28, 1, "SPEED"
  Tiles.Text 1, 29, "SCORE"
  Tiles.Text 30, 29, "WAVE"
  Hud
End Sub

Sub Bar(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal v As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, n As Integer
  n = v * 48 \ 100
  For k = 0 To 5
    If n >= 8 Then
      Tiles.Put x + k, 1, t + 8
    ElseIf n > 0 Then
      Tiles.Put x + k, 1, t + n
    Else
      Tiles.Put x + k, 1, t
    End If
    n = n - 8
  Next
End Sub

Sub Hud()
  Bar 8, shield, GfxData.T_BARG
  Bar 21, heat, GfxData.T_BARO
  Bar 34, speed, GfxData.T_BARG
  Tiles.Text 1, 30, Format$(score, "0000000")
  Tiles.Text 30, 30, Format$(wave, "00") & " " & CStr(left1) & " "
  Tiles.Text 30, 31, "SHIPS " & CStr(lives)
End Sub

Sub Message(ByVal s As String)
  Tiles.Rect 6, 3, 28, 1, GfxData.T_BLACK
  If s <> "" Then Tiles.Text 20 - Len(s) \ 2, 3, s
End Sub

Sub BigText(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal colour As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer, r As Integer, b As Integer, bits As Integer, ch As String
  For n = 1 To Len(s)
    ch = Mid$(s, n, 1)
    For r = 0 To 4
      bits = Glyph(ch, r)
      For b = 0 To 2
        If bits And (4 \ (2 ^ b)) Then Tiles.Put x + b, y + r, GfxData.T_LOGO + colour
      Next
    Next
    x = x + 4
  Next
End Sub

Function Glyph(ByVal ch As String, ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
  Dim p As String
  Select Case ch
    Case "S": p = "74717"
    Case "O": p = "75557"
    Case "L": p = "44447"
    Case "A": p = "25755"
    Case "R": p = "75654"
    Case Else: p = "00000"
  End Select
  Glyph = Val(Mid$(p, r + 1, 1))
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
  Dim k As Integer, m As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 32
  Spr.Show
  L2.Wipe
  Frame : L2.Flip
  L2.Wipe
  Nx.Layers Nx.OrderUSL                     ' the title's text over Layer 2
  Tiles.Fill GfxData.T_BLACK
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 24, 0                ' see-through: Layer 2 shows
  BigText 10, 0, "SOLAR", 0
  Tiles.Text 3, 28, "Q A PITCH  O P TURN  Z X ROLL"
  Tiles.Text 3, 29, "SPACE FIRE  M FASTER  N SLOWER"
  Tiles.Text 3, 30, "KEMPSTON: STEER AND FIRE"
  Tiles.Text 3, 31, "HI " & Format$(hiscore, "0000000") & "    PRESS SPACE"
  View.Init
  View.SetCam 0, 0, -700
  m = 0 : frames = 0 : firewas = -1
  Do
    L2.Clear
    View.TurnB VarPtr(tbas), 0, 1, (frames \ 64) And 1
    If (frames And 127) = 0 Then m = (m + 1) Mod 4
    View.Begin
    View.Model 0, 0, 0, Models.Base() + Choose(m + 1, Models.M_KESTREL, Models.M_DART, Models.M_HORNET, Models.M_MANTIS), VarPtr(tbas)
    L2.Lines View.Count, View.Table, Choose(m + 1, &H1F, &HE0, &HFC, &HE3 - 2)
    Frame
    L2.Flip
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1 : seed = seed + 1
    Tiles.Text 12, 26, Choose(m + 1, "YOUR KESTREL   ", "DART   PIRATE  ", "HORNET PIRATE  ", "MANTIS PIRATE  ")
  Loop Until FirePressed()
  Nx.Seed seed
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Play()
  Dim k As Integer
  score = 0 : wave = 0 : over = 0 : dead = 0 : lives = 3
  StartShip
  NewStars
  Rocks
  For k = 0 To 31
    pl(k) = 0
  Next
  L2.Wipe
  Frame : L2.Flip
  L2.Wipe
  Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSLU
  Panels
  Spr.Put 0, 152, 120, GfxData.S_CROSS, 0
  waveT = 50
  For k = 0 To NE - 1
    eon(k) = 0
  Next
  left1 = 0
  Do
    L2.Clear
    Orbits
    If dead = 0 Then Steer Else Dying
    Stars
    Bodies
    RockField
    Pirates
    Sparks
    Laser
    Hazards
    Scanner
    Waves
    hudT = hudT + 1
    If (hudT And 7) = 0 Then Hud
    Frame
    L2.Flip
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
  Loop Until over
End Sub

' the ship at the start: out past the ice world, the sun ahead to the right
Sub StartShip()
  shield = 100 : heat = 0 : speed = 20
  View.Init
  View.SetCam -5200, 400, -6200
  View.TurnB View.CamBasis(), 0, 2, 0
  View.TurnB View.CamBasis(), 0, 2, 0
  View.TurnB View.CamBasis(), 0, 2, 0
  View.TurnB View.CamBasis(), 0, 2, 0
  View.TurnB View.CamBasis(), 0, 2, 0
End Sub

Sub Steer()
  Dim p As Integer, y As Integer, r As Integer, j As Integer
  j = Keys.Joystick(0)
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or (j And Keys.JoyDown) Then p = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or (j And Keys.JoyUp) Then p = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or (j And Keys.JoyLeft) Then y = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or (j And Keys.JoyRight) Then y = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ) Then r = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyX) Then r = 1
  If p <> 0 Or y <> 0 Or r <> 0 Then View.TurnB View.CamBasis(), p, y, r
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) And speed < 100 Then speed = speed + 2
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyN) And speed > 0 Then speed = speed - 2
  View.Move View.CamPos(), View.CamBasis(), speed
  ' fire
  If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - 1
  firing = 0
  If (Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (j And Keys.JoyFire1)) And cool = 0 And heat < 92 Then
    firing = 1 : cool = 3 : heat = heat + 7
    Sfx.Play 0, 30, 6, 12, 6, 0
  ElseIf heat > 0 Then
    heat = heat - 1
  End If
End Sub

Sub Stars()
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To NSTAR - 1
    If View.Dir(sdx(k), sdy(k), sdz(k)) Then L2.Plot View.px, View.py, C_STAR
  Next
End Sub

' the sun and the planets: a circle, and an equator and a meridian for a globe
Sub Bodies()
  Dim k As Integer, r As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer
  For k = 0 To 4
    If View.Project(bx(k), by(k), bz(k)) Then
      If View.pz > 40 Then
        r = View.MulDiv(br(k), 128, View.pz)
        If r > 1 And r < 2000 Then
          x = View.px : y = View.py
          View.Begin
          View.Ellipse x, y, r, r
          If k = 0 Then
            View.Ellipse x, y, r * 3 \ 4, r * 3 \ 4
            L2.Lines View.Count, View.Table, C_SUN
            View.Begin
            View.Line x - r * 3 \ 2, y, x - r * 9 \ 8, y
            View.Line x + r * 3 \ 2, y, x + r * 9 \ 8, y
            View.Line x, y - r * 3 \ 2, x, y - r * 9 \ 8
            View.Line x, y + r * 3 \ 2, x, y + r * 9 \ 8
            L2.Lines View.Count, View.Table, C_SUN2
          Else
            If r > 16 Then View.Ellipse x, y, r, r \ 3
            If r > 28 Then View.Ellipse x, y, r \ 3, r
            If k = 3 Then View.Ellipse x, y, r * 7 \ 4, r \ 2
            L2.Lines View.Count, View.Table, bc(k)
          End If
        ElseIf r <= 1 Then
          L2.Plot View.px, View.py, bc(k)
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub RockField()
  Dim k As Integer
  View.TurnB VarPtr(rbas), 1, 0, 0
  View.Begin
  For k = 0 To NR - 1
    If View.Project(rpos(k * 3), rpos(k * 3 + 1), rpos(k * 3 + 2)) Then
      If View.pz < 3500 Then
        View.Model rpos(k * 3), rpos(k * 3 + 1), rpos(k * 3 + 2), Models.Base() + Models.M_ROCK, VarPtr(rbas)
      Else
        L2.Plot View.px, View.py, &H92
      End If
    End If
  Next
  L2.Lines View.Count, View.Table, &H92
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- pirates
Sub Waves()
  Dim k As Integer, n As Integer
  If left1 > 0 Or dead > 0 Then Exit Sub
  waveT = waveT - 1
  If waveT = 30 Then
    wave = wave + 1
    Message "WAVE " & CStr(wave) & " - PIRATES INCOMING"
    Sfx.Play 2, 400, -12, 12, 30, 0
  End If
  If waveT > 0 Then Exit Sub
  n = wave + 1
  If n > NE Then n = NE
  For k = 0 To n - 1
    AddPirate k
  Next
  left1 = n
  waveT = 120
  If shield < 100 Then shield = shield + 25
  If shield > 100 Then shield = 100
  Message ""
End Sub

Sub AddPirate(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim a As Integer, d As Integer, b As Integer, k As Integer
  ' somewhere 2500-4000 away from the camera, inside the system
  a = Rnd(256) : d = 2500 + Rnd(1500)
  epos(n * 3) = View.CamX() + CLng(d) * Models.Sine((a + 64) And 255) \ 16384
  epos(n * 3 + 1) = View.CamY() + Rnd(1600) - 800
  epos(n * 3 + 2) = View.CamZ() + CLng(d) * Models.Sine(a) \ 16384
  For k = 0 To 2
    If epos(n * 3 + k) > WORLD - 500 Then epos(n * 3 + k) = WORLD - 500
    If epos(n * 3 + k) < 500 - WORLD Then epos(n * 3 + k) = 500 - WORLD
  Next
  b = n * 9
  For k = 0 To 8
    ebas(b + k) = 0
  Next
  ebas(b) = 16384 : ebas(b + 4) = 16384 : ebas(b + 8) = 16384
  eon(n) = 1 : ecool(n) = 60 + Rnd(60) : eturn(n) = 0
  ek(n) = Rnd(3)
  If wave < 2 Then ek(n) = 0
  ehp(n) = 2 + ek(n) * 2
  espd(n) = 24 + ek(n) * 6 + wave * 2
  If espd(n) > 60 Then espd(n) = 60
End Sub

Sub Pirates()
  Dim n As Integer, b As Integer, p As Integer, y As Integer, d As Integer, dx As Integer, dy As Integer, dz As Integer
  Dim m As Integer, c As Integer, n3 As Integer
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If eon(n) Then
      n3 = n * 3
      b = VarPtr(ebas) + n * 18
      dx = View.CamX() - epos(n3) : dy = View.CamY() - epos(n3 + 1) : dz = View.CamZ() - epos(n3 + 2)
      d = Abs(dx)
      If Abs(dy) > d Then d = Abs(dy)
      If Abs(dz) > d Then d = Abs(dz)
      ' steer: towards the player, or away for a while when too close
      View.Local b, dx, dy, dz
      p = 0 : y = 0
      If ((n + frames) And 1) Then
        ' (it thinks every other frame)
      ElseIf eturn(n) > 0 Then
        eturn(n) = eturn(n) - 1
        p = 1 : y = 1
      Else
        If View.lx > View.lz \ 8 Or View.lz < 0 Then y = 1
        If View.lx < -(View.lz \ 8) Then y = -1
        If View.ly > View.lz \ 8 Then p = 1
        If View.ly < -(View.lz \ 8) Then p = -1
        If d < 350 Then eturn(n) = 40
      End If
      If p <> 0 Or y <> 0 Then View.TurnB b, p * 2, y * 2, 0
      View.Move VarPtr(epos) + n * 6, b, espd(n)
      ' fire when lined up and near
      If ecool(n) > 0 Then ecool(n) = ecool(n) - 1
      If ecool(n) = 0 And d < 2600 And View.lz > 0 And dead = 0 Then
        If Abs(View.lx) < View.lz \ 5 And Abs(View.ly) < View.lz \ 5 Then
          ecool(n) = 40 + Rnd(40) - wave * 3
          If ecool(n) < 15 Then ecool(n) = 15
          If View.Project(epos(n3), epos(n3 + 1), epos(n3 + 2)) Then
            L2.Line View.px, View.py, 128 + Rnd(40) - 20, 150, &HE7
          End If
          Sfx.Play 1, 60, 8, 12, 10, 0
          If Rnd(100) < 70 - d \ 50 Then
            shield = shield - 6 - ek(n) * 2
            Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, 0, &H60    ' the panels flash red
            If shield <= 0 Then
              shield = 0 : PlayerDies
            End If
          End If
        End If
      End If
      ' drawn: far off, a dot
      c = Choose(ek(n) + 1, &HE0, &HFC, &HE3 - 2)
      If View.Project(epos(n3), epos(n3 + 1), epos(n3 + 2)) Then
        If View.pz > 4000 Then
          L2.Plot View.px, View.py, c
        Else
          View.Begin
          m = Choose(ek(n) + 1, Models.M_DART, Models.M_HORNET, Models.M_MANTIS)
          View.Model epos(n3), epos(n3 + 1), epos(n3 + 2), Models.Base() + m, b
          L2.Lines View.Count, View.Table, c
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
  If (frames And 3) = 0 Then Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, 0, 0
End Sub

' the lasers: two beams to the sights, and what they hit
Sub Laser()
  Dim n As Integer, s As Integer
  If firing = 0 Then Exit Sub
  L2.Line 8, 191, 126, 98, C_LASER
  L2.Line 247, 191, 130, 98, C_LASER
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If eon(n) Then
      If View.Project(epos(n * 3), epos(n * 3 + 1), epos(n * 3 + 2)) Then
        If View.pz < 6000 Then
          s = View.MulDiv(100, 128, View.pz) + 4
          If Abs(View.px - 128) < s And Abs(View.py - 96) < s Then
            ehp(n) = ehp(n) - 1
            Spark View.px, View.py, &HFC, 4
            Sfx.Play 1, 4, 1, 12, 6, 1
            If ehp(n) <= 0 Then
              eon(n) = 0 : left1 = left1 - 1
              Spark View.px, View.py, &HFF, 14
              Spark View.px, View.py, &HE8, 10
              Sfx.Play 1, 24, 1, 15, 40, 1
              score = score + 100 * (ek(n) + 1) * (wave + 1) \ 2 + 50
              If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
              Hud
            End If
            Exit For
          End If
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' too near the sun or a planet, or out of the system
Sub Hazards()
  Dim k As Integer, d As Integer, dx As Integer, dy As Integer, dz As Integer, w As Integer
  If dead Then Exit Sub
  w = 0
  For k = 0 To 4
    dx = Abs(View.CamX() - bx(k)) : dy = Abs(View.CamY() - by(k)) : dz = Abs(View.CamZ() - bz(k))
    d = dx
    If dy > d Then d = dy
    If dz > d Then d = dz
    If d < br(k) Then
      shield = 0 : PlayerDies : Exit Sub
    End If
    If k = 0 And d < 1800 Then
      w = 1
      If (frames And 3) = 0 Then shield = shield - 1
      If shield <= 0 Then
        shield = 0 : PlayerDies : Exit Sub
      End If
    End If
  Next
  If Abs(View.CamX()) > WORLD Or Abs(View.CamY()) > WORLD Or Abs(View.CamZ()) > WORLD Then
    w = 2
    ' turned back in
    View.SetCam View.CamX() * 15 \ 16, View.CamY() * 15 \ 16, View.CamZ() * 15 \ 16
  End If
  If w <> warnWas Then
    If w = 1 Then Message "TOO HOT - THE SUN"
    If w = 2 Then Message "EDGE OF THE SYSTEM"
    If w = 0 Then Message ""
    warnWas = w
  End If
End Sub

Sub PlayerDies()
  dead = 120
  Spark 128, 96, &HFF, 20
  Spark 128, 96, &HE0, 12
  Sfx.Play 1, 31, 0, 15, 90, 1
  Sfx.Play 0, 200, 10, 15, 80, 0
  Message "SHIP LOST"
  Hud
End Sub

Sub Dying()
  Dim k As Integer
  dead = dead - 1
  Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, 0, (dead And 4) * 24
  If dead = 0 Then
    lives = lives - 1
    If lives = 0 Then
      over = 1
    Else
      ' a new ship; the pirates go back a way
      StartShip
      For k = 0 To NE - 1
        If eon(k) Then AddPirate k
      Next
      Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, 0, 0
      Message ""
      Hud
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- sparks (on the screen)
Sub Spark(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer, ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, a As Integer
  For k = 1 To n
    a = Rnd(256)
    pl(pnext) = 10 + Rnd(14)
    ppx(pnext) = x * 16 : ppy(pnext) = y * 16
    pvx(pnext) = Models.Sine((a + 64) And 255) * (1 + Rnd(4)) \ 512
    pvy(pnext) = Models.Sine(a) * (1 + Rnd(4)) \ 512
    pnext = (pnext + 1) And 31
  Next
End Sub

Sub Sparks()
  Dim k As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer
  For k = 0 To 31
    If pl(k) Then
      pl(k) = pl(k) - 1
      ppx(k) = ppx(k) + pvx(k) : ppy(k) = ppy(k) + pvy(k)
      x = ppx(k) \ 16 : y = ppy(k) \ 16
      L2.Line x, y, x - pvx(k) \ 16, y - pvy(k) \ 16, Choose((k And 3) + 1, &HFF, &HFC, &HF0, &HE0)
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the scanner
' a blip for each pirate, planet and the sun: across = right, up the scanner = ahead
Sub Scanner()
  Dim n As Integer, s As Integer
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    s = 10 + n
    If eon(n) Then
      Blip s, epos(n * 3), epos(n * 3 + 1), epos(n * 3 + 2), GfxData.S_BLIP, 1
    Else
      Spr.Hide s
    End If
  Next
  For n = 0 To 4
    If n = 0 Then
      Blip 20, 0, 0, 0, GfxData.S_SBLIP, 0
    Else
      Blip 20 + n, bx(n), by(n), bz(n), GfxData.S_PBLIP, 0
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub Blip(ByVal s As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal stalk As Integer)
  Dim bx1 As Integer, by1 As Integer
  View.Local View.CamBasis(), x - View.CamX(), y - View.CamY(), z - View.CamZ()
  bx1 = View.lx \ 128 : by1 = View.lz \ 512
  If bx1 > 60 Or bx1 < -60 Or by1 > 13 Or by1 < -13 Then
    Spr.Hide s
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If stalk Then
    If View.ly > 300 Then pat = pat + 1
    If View.ly < -300 Then pat = pat + 2
  End If
  Spr.Put s, 160 + bx1 - 8, 240 - by1 - 8, pat, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the end
Sub GameOver()
  Dim n As Integer
  Message "GAME OVER"
  Spr.HideRange 0, 32
  For n = 1 To 150
    L2.Clear
    Stars
    Bodies
    Sparks
    Frame
    L2.Flip
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    If n > 50 And FirePressed() Then Exit For
  Next
  Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, 0, 0
  Sfx.Quiet
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: L2.cls
files.text:
' L2 - Layer 2 on the ZX Spectrum Next: 256 x 192, 256 colours, two buffers (draw on one while
' the other is shown), clipped lines and points, straight on the hardware.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' The buffers are 16K banks 16-18 and 19-21 (8K pages 32-37, 38-43). Drawing maps the page it
' needs into MMU slot 6 (#C000-#DFFF) and puts bank 5's first half back after (the tilemap's
' tiles live there). Colours are the Layer 2 palette's: as the Next starts, the colour number is
' its colour (RRRGGGBB); #E3 is transparent (what is under Layer 2 shows through).
' Every line drawn is kept in a list for its buffer, so Clear takes them off again by drawing
' them in the background colour - far quicker than wiping 48K when a frame has a few hundred
' lines. A frame:
'     L2.Clear                 ' the lines drawn on this buffer last time, gone
'     L2.Line ...              ' draw (up to 1024 lines and points a frame)
'     Frame : L2.Flip          ' show it at the frame's end, draw on the other next
' Coordinates are signed: a line partly or wholly off the screen is cut to it.
Option Explicit

Private lg(8191) As Byte          ' two lists of up to 1024 lines: x0, y0, x1, y1
Private cnt0 As Integer, cnt1 As Integer
Private cur As Integer            ' the buffer drawn on: 0 = bank 16, 1 = bank 19
Private bankA As Integer, bankB As Integer
Private bg As Integer
Private sps As Integer

' Init backColour: Layer 2 on (256 x 192), both buffers wiped to that colour, the first shown
Public Sub Init(ByVal backColour As Integer)
  bankA = 16 : bankB = 19 : bg = backColour And 255
  cnt0 = 0 : cnt1 = 0
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0                         ' 256 x 192
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1                         ' its clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0        ' no scroll
  cur = 1
  Wipe
  cur = 0
  Wipe
  Nx.Reg &H12, bankB                     ' bank 19 shown, 16 drawn on
  Out &H123B, 2                          ' Layer 2 visible
End Sub

' Off: Layer 2 hidden
Public Sub Off()
  Out &H123B, 0
End Sub

' Wipe: the whole buffer drawn on, the background colour (and its list emptied)
Public Sub Wipe()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp          ; the real stack (call / ret inside)
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            ld a, ({bankA})
            jr z, bs_a
            ld a, ({bankB})
bs_a:
            add a, a
            ld (dl_base), a
            ld b, 6
wp_lp:
            push bc

            call cl_code

            ld de, (cl_y1)
            call cl_code

            ld a, (cl_c0)

            jr z, cl_in             ; both in
            ld a, (cl_c0)

            jr nz, cl_out           ; both off the same side
            dec b
            jr z, cl_out
            push bc
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            or a
            jr z, cl_p1

            pop bc
            jr cl_again

            call cl_swap            ; point 1 is out: swap, move, swap back

            call cl_swap
            pop bc
            jr cl_again

            ld (dl_x0), a
            ld a, (cl_y0)
            ld (dl_y0), a
            ld a, (cl_x1)
            ld (dl_x1), a
            ld a, (cl_y1)
            ld (dl_y1), a
            or a
            ret

            scf
            ret

            bit 7, h
            jr z, cl_cx1
            or 1
            jr cl_cy
cl_cx1:
            inc h
            dec h
            jr z, cl_cy
            or 2
cl_cy:
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_cy1
            or 4
            ret
cl_cy1:
            ld c, a
            ld a, d
            or a
            jr nz, cl_cy2
            ld a, e
            cp 192
            ld a, c
            ret c
            or 8
            ret
cl_cy2:
            ld a, c
            or 8
            ret
cl_swap:

            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; x1 - x0

            call cl_muls            ; DEHL = (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0)
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a

            ld b, h
            ld c, l                 ; y1 - y0
            pop hl
            pop de

            add hl, de

            ld (cl_y0), hl

            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_y1)

            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl

            push hl

            ld b, h

            ld de, (cl_y0)
            add hl, de

            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ret
; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
cl_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a

            sub c

            sla e
            rl d
            jr nc, cl_m4

            inc hl

            ret z

            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
            ret

            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a

            bit 7, b

            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_d2:
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, cl_d3
            ld hl, 0
            ret
cl_d3:
            ; DEHL / BC: the remainder in DE as the dividend's bits come in from HL
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ; first make sure the high word is below the divisor (else the quotient is > 16 bits): clamp
            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, cl_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr cl_d7
cl_d4:
            add hl, bc
cl_d5:
            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, cl_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, cl_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr cl_d6n

cl_d6:
            inc e

            ld a, (cl_n)

            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_d5
            ex de, hl               ; HL = quotient

            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret

            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)

            ld a, (hl)

            ld h, (hl)

            jr nz, sh_slow

            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_x1)

            sbc hl, de

            ld c, l

            ld de, (cl_y0)

            push hl

            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a

            jr z, cl_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d

            jr z, cl_m2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a

            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a

            bit 7, b

            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b

            jr nz, cl_d3

            jr c, cl_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr cl_d7

            add hl, bc

            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, cl_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, cl_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr cl_d6n

            or a
            sbc hl, bc

            inc e

            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a

            jr nz, cl_d5

            ld a, (cl_sg)

            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret

            ld a, (cl_c0)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cl_c1)
            ld (cl_c0), a
            ld a, c
            ld (cl_c1), a
            ret
; point 0 moved onto the edge its code names first (above, below, left, right)
cl_cut0:
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            bit 2, a
            jr z, cl_cb
            ld hl, 0                ; above: y = 0
            jr cl_cuty
cl_cb:
            bit 3, a
            jr z, cl_cl
            ld hl, 191              ; below: y = 191
cl_cuty:
            ; x0 = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0) / (y1 - y0) ; y0 = edge
            ld (cl_e), hl
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; edge - y0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; x1 - x0
            ex de, hl
            call cl_muls            ; DEHL = (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0)
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l                 ; y1 - y0
            pop hl
            pop de
            call cl_divs            ; HL = DEHL / BC
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            add hl, de
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ld hl, (cl_e)
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ret
cl_cl:
            bit 0, a
            jr z, cl_cr
            ld hl, 0                ; left: x = 0
            jr cl_cutx
cl_cr:
            ld hl, 255              ; right: x = 255
cl_cutx:
            ld (cl_e), hl
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            call cl_muls
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            pop hl
            pop de
            call cl_divs
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            add hl, de
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ld hl, (cl_e)
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ret
; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
cl_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
cl_m1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cl_m2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_m2:
            ld hl, 0                ; DE x BC unsigned -> HL:IX? (kept: HL high, (cl_lo) low)
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ld ix, 0
cl_m3:
            add ix, ix
            adc hl, hl
            sla e
            rl d
            jr nc, cl_m4
            add ix, bc
            jr nc, cl_m4
            inc hl
cl_m4:
            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a
            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_m3
            ex de, hl               ; DE high
            push ix
            pop hl                  ; HL low
            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            ; negate DEHL
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
            ret
; HL = DEHL / BC, signed (the quotient's low 16 bits; |divisor| > 0)
cl_divs:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
cl_d1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cl_d2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_d2:
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, cl_d3
            ld hl, 0
            ret
cl_d3:
            ; DEHL / BC: the remainder in DE as the dividend's bits come in from HL
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ; first make sure the high word is below the divisor (else the quotient is > 16 bits): clamp
            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, cl_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr cl_d7
cl_d4:
            add hl, bc
cl_d5:
            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, cl_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, cl_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr cl_d6n
cl_d5b:
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
cl_d6:
            inc e
cl_d6n:
            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a
            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_d5
            ex de, hl               ; HL = quotient
cl_d7:
            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret
cl_x0:      dw 0
cl_y0:      dw 0
cl_x1:      dw 0
cl_y1:      dw 0
cl_c0:      db 0
cl_c1:      db 0
cl_e:       dw 0
cl_sg:      db 0
cl_n:       db 0

; ---- draw: dl_x0, dl_y0 -> dl_x1, dl_y1 (on the screen) in colour dl_c, Layer 2 pages from dl_base
dl_line:
            ld a, (dl_x1)
            ld hl, dl_x0
            sub (hl)
            ld c, #2C               ; inc l
            jr nc, dl_px
            neg
            ld c, #2D               ; dec l
dl_px:
            ld (dl_dx), a
            ld a, c
            ld (dl_xm1), a
            ld (dl_xm2), a
            ld a, (dl_y1)
            ld hl, dl_y0
            sub (hl)
            ld c, #24               ; inc h
            jr nc, dl_py
            neg
            ld c, #25               ; dec h
dl_py:
            ld (dl_dy), a
            ld a, c
            ld (dl_ym1), a
            ld (dl_ym2), a
            ld a, (dl_y0)
            ld e, a
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld a, (dl_x0)
            ld l, a
            ld a, e
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld e, a
            ld a, (dl_base)
            add a, e
            ld (dl_page), a
            call dl_map
            ld a, (dl_c)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (dl_dx)
            ld d, a
            ld a, (dl_dy)
            ld e, a
            cp d
            jr nc, dl_ymaj
            ld b, d                 ; x major: dx + 1 pixels
            inc b
            ld a, d
            srl a
dl_xl:
            ld (hl), c
dl_xm1:
            inc l
            sub e
            jr nc, dl_xn
            add a, d
dl_ym1:
            inc h
            ex af, af'
            ld a, h
            and #E0
            cp #C0
            call nz, dl_wrap
            ex af, af'
dl_xn:
            djnz dl_xl
            ret
dl_ymaj:
            ld b, e                 ; y major: dy + 1 pixels
            inc b
            ld a, e
            srl a
dl_yl:
            ld (hl), c
dl_ym2:
            inc h
            ex af, af'
            ld a, h
            and #E0
            cp #C0
            call nz, dl_wrap
            ex af, af'
            sub d
            jr nc, dl_yn
            add a, e
dl_xm2:
            inc l
dl_yn:
            djnz dl_yl
            ret
; H went off the 8K page: the next one (down) or the one before (up)
dl_wrap:
            ld a, h
            cp #E0
            jr nz, dl_wup
            ld h, #C0
            ld a, (dl_page)
            inc a
            jr dl_wset
dl_wup:
            ld h, #DF
            ld a, (dl_page)
            dec a
dl_wset:
            ld (dl_page), a
dl_map:
            push bc
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56               ; MMU slot 6 (#C000-#DFFF)
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (dl_page)
            out (c), a
            pop bc
            ret
dl_x0:      db 0
dl_y0:      db 0
dl_x1:      db 0
dl_y1:      db 0
dl_c:       db 0
dl_dx:      db 0
dl_dy:      db 0
dl_page:    db 0
dl_base:    db 0
; ---- the line just drawn (dl_x0 ..) into the back buffer's list, for Clear
lg_add:
            ld hl, ({cnt0})
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            jr z, lg_a
            ld hl, ({cnt1})
lg_a:
            ld de, 1024
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret nc                  ; the list is full: not logged (it stays on the screen)
            add hl, de
            ld e, l
            ld d, h
            inc hl
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            jr nz, lg_b
            ld ({cnt0}), hl
            ld hl, {lg}
            jr lg_c
lg_b:
            ld ({cnt1}), hl
            ld hl, {lg} + 4096
lg_c:
            ex de, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; the entry: base + n * 4
            ld a, (dl_x0)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_y0)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_x1)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_y1)
            ld (hl), a
            ret
#endasm
End Sub

' Back(): the buffer drawn on (0 / 1)
Public Function Back() As Integer
  Back = cur
End Function

' Used(): lines and points drawn on this buffer since its Clear
Public Function Used() As Integer
  If cur Then Used = cnt1 Else Used = cnt0
End Function

' View - a 3D view for Layer 2: a camera that turns and moves, points projected onto the
' 256 x 192 screen, wireframe models and ellipses made into a table of lines for L2.Lines.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' World coordinates are Integers: keep everything within +-9000 on each axis (so the distance
' between two things fits 16 bits). Directions are bases of three vectors - right, up, forward
' - in 2.14 fixed point (16384 = 1.0): 9 Integers, kept square by TurnB. x is right, y up, z
' forward. The screen: x' * 128 / z' across from the middle (128, 96), up is up.
'   View.Begin
'   View.Model x, y, z, View.ModelAt(n), VarPtr(basis)     ' a ship's lines into the table
'   L2.Lines View.Count, View.Table, colour                 ' drawn
' All the sums are Z80 (#asm); every block switches to the real stack for its calls.
Option Explicit

Public Const NEAR = 16              ' nearer than this (z') is not drawn
Public px As Integer, py As Integer, pz As Integer      ' Project / Dir: the point on the screen, its depth
Public lx As Integer, ly As Integer, lz As Integer      ' Local: a vector in a basis's terms
Public nl As Integer                                    ' lines in the table
Private lb(599) As Integer                              ' the table: 150 lines of x0, y0, x1, y1
Private cam(2) As Integer                               ' the camera: where
Private cb(8) As Integer                                ' and its basis
Private sps As Integer

' Init: the camera at the origin looking along z
Public Sub Init()
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To 8
    cb(k) = 0
  Next
  cb(0) = 16384 : cb(4) = 16384 : cb(8) = 16384
  cam(0) = 0 : cam(1) = 0 : cam(2) = 0
End Sub

Public Sub SetCam(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer)
  cam(0) = x : cam(1) = y : cam(2) = z
End Sub

Public Function CamX() As Integer
  CamX = cam(0)
End Function
Public Function CamY() As Integer
  CamY = cam(1)
End Function
Public Function CamZ() As Integer
  CamZ = cam(2)
End Function
' the camera's position (3 Integers) and basis (9), for Move / TurnB / Local
Public Function CamPos() As Integer
  CamPos = VarPtr(cam)
End Function
Public Function CamBasis() As Integer
  CamBasis = VarPtr(cb)
End Function
Public Function Table() As Integer
  Table = VarPtr(lb)
End Function
Public Function Count() As Integer
  Count = nl
End Function

' Begin: the line table emptied
Public Sub Begin()
  nl = 0
End Sub

' Line x0, y0, x1, y1: a line (screen coordinates) into the table
Public Sub Line(ByVal x0 As Integer, ByVal y0 As Integer, ByVal x1 As Integer, ByVal y1 As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer
  If nl >= 150 Then Exit Sub
  k = nl * 4
  lb(k) = x0 : lb(k + 1) = y0 : lb(k + 2) = x1 : lb(k + 3) = y1
  nl = nl + 1
End Sub

' Project(x, y, z): True when the world point is in front of the camera; px, py its place on the
' screen (maybe off it), pz its depth
Public Function Project(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (vm_v), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (vm_v + 2), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (vm_v + 4), hl
            pop hl
            ld (pr_r), hl
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld hl, (vm_v)           ; relative to the camera
            ld de, ({cam})
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (vm_v), hl
            ld hl, (vm_v + 2)
            ld de, ({cam} + 2)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (vm_v + 2), hl
            ld hl, (vm_v + 4)
            ld de, ({cam} + 4)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (vm_v + 4), hl
            ld iy, {cb}
            call vm_dot
            ld (vc_x), hl
            ld iy, {cb} + 6
            call vm_dot
            ld (vc_y), hl
            ld iy, {cb} + 12
            call vm_dot
            ld (vc_z), hl
            ld hl, (vc_z)
            ld (pr_z), hl
            ld de, 16
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, pr_no            ; behind (or too near): not seen
            ld hl, (vc_x)
            ld bc, (vc_z)
            call vm_proj
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            ld (pr_x), hl
            ld hl, (vc_y)
            ld bc, (vc_z)
            call vm_proj
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 96
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (pr_y), hl
            ld hl, (pr_x)
            ld ({px}), hl
            ld hl, (pr_y)
            ld ({py}), hl
            ld hl, (pr_z)
            ld ({pz}), hl
            ld de, -1
            jr pr_set
pr_no:
            ld hl, (pr_z)
            ld ({pz}), hl
            ld de, 0
pr_set:

            ld hl, (pr_r)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret
pr_r:       dw 0
pr_x:       dw 0
pr_y:       dw 0
pr_z:       dw 0
vc_x:       dw 0
vc_y:       dw 0
vc_z:       dw 0
; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
vm_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (vm_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, vm_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
vm_m1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, vm_m2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
vm_m2:
            call vm_umul            ; DEHL = DE * BC, unsigned
            ld a, (vm_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            ; negate DEHL
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
            ret
; HL = DEHL / BC, signed (the quotient's low 16 bits; |divisor| > 0)
vm_divs:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (vm_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, vm_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
vm_d1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, vm_d2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
vm_d2:
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, vm_d3
            ld hl, 0
            ret
vm_d3:
            ; DEHL / BC: the remainder in DE as the dividend's bits come in from HL
            ; first make sure the high word is below the divisor (else the quotient is > 16 bits): clamp
            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, vm_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr vm_d7
vm_d4:
            add hl, bc
            ld a, 16
vm_d5:
            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, vm_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, vm_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr vm_d6n
vm_d5b:
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
vm_d6:
            inc e
vm_d6n:
            dec a
            jr nz, vm_d5
            ex de, hl               ; HL = quotient
vm_d7:
            ld a, (vm_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret

; DEHL = DE * BC, unsigned: four 8 x 8 products on the Next's multiplier
vm_umul:
            ld (vm_ua), de
            ld (vm_ub), bc
            ld d, e                 ; a low x b low
            ld e, c
vm_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            ld (vm_lo), de
            ld a, (vm_ua + 1)       ; a high x b high
            ld d, a
            ld a, (vm_ub + 1)
            ld e, a
vm_zm2:
            db #ED, #30
            ld (vm_hi), de
            ld a, (vm_ua)           ; a low x b high
            ld d, a
            ld e, b
vm_zm3:
            db #ED, #30
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (vm_ua + 1)       ; a high x b low
            ld d, a
            ld e, c
vm_zm4:
            db #ED, #30
            add hl, de              ; the middle: 17 bits (A = its top bit)
            ld a, 0
            adc a, a
            ld b, a
            ld de, (vm_lo)
            ld a, d
            add a, l
            ld d, a
            ld a, h
            ld hl, (vm_hi)
            adc a, l
            ld l, a
            ld a, b
            adc a, h
            ld h, a
            ex de, hl               ; DE = the high word, HL = the low
            ret
vm_ua:      dw 0
vm_ub:      dw 0
vm_lo:      dw 0
vm_hi:      dw 0

; HL = DE * BC >> 14 (2.14 fixed point, signed)
vm_fix:
            call vm_muls
            add hl, hl
            rl e
            rl d
            add hl, hl
            rl e
            rl d
            ex de, hl
            ret
; HL = DE * BC >> 12 (a model's byte coordinates are 4 world units)
vm_f12:
            call vm_muls
            ld a, 4
vm_f12a:
            add hl, hl
            rl e
            rl d
            dec a
            jr nz, vm_f12a
            ex de, hl
            ret
; HL = vm_v . (IY), 3 words each, >> 14
vm_dot:
            ld e, (iy + 0)
            ld d, (iy + 1)
            ld bc, (vm_v)
            call vm_fix
            ld (vm_acc), hl
            ld e, (iy + 2)
            ld d, (iy + 3)
            ld bc, (vm_v + 2)
            call vm_fix
            ld de, (vm_acc)
            add hl, de
            ld (vm_acc), hl
            ld e, (iy + 4)
            ld d, (iy + 5)
            ld bc, (vm_v + 4)
            call vm_fix
            ld de, (vm_acc)
            add hl, de
            ret
; HL = HL * 128 / BC (BC > 0), kept within +-12000
vm_proj:
            ld a, h                 ; DEHL = HL sign extended, times 128
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, a
            ld a, 7
vm_pr1:
            add hl, hl
            rl e
            rl d
            dec a
            jr nz, vm_pr1
            call vm_divs
vm_clamp:
            ld de, 12000
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, vm_cneg
            push hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            pop hl
            ret c
            ex de, hl
            ret
vm_cneg:
            push hl
            add hl, de
            pop hl
            ret c
            ld hl, -12000
            ret
vm_v:       dw 0, 0, 0
vm_acc:     dw 0
vm_sg:      db 0
vm_n:       db 0

#endasm
End Function

' Dir(x, y, z): as Project, for a direction (a star: as far as you go, it stays put)
Public Function Dir(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (vm_v), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (vm_v + 2), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (vm_v + 4), hl
            pop hl
            ld (pr_r), hl
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld iy, {cb}
            call vm_dot
            ld (vc_x), hl
            ld iy, {cb} + 6
            call vm_dot
            ld (vc_y), hl
            ld iy, {cb} + 12
            call vm_dot
            ld (vc_z), hl
            ld hl, (vc_z)
            ld (pr_z), hl
            ld de, 16
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, pr_no            ; behind (or too near): not seen
            ld hl, (vc_x)
            ld bc, (vc_z)
            call vm_proj
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            ld (pr_x), hl
            ld hl, (vc_y)
            ld bc, (vc_z)
            call vm_proj
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 96
            or a
            sbc hl, de

; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
vm_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (vm_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, vm_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a

            jr z, vm_m2

            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a

            ld a, (vm_sg)

            ret z

            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a

vm_divs:

            xor b
            ld (vm_sg), a

            jr z, vm_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h

            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0

            ld d, a

            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a

            or c
            jr nz, vm_d3

            ; first make sure the high word is below the divisor (else the quotient is > 16 bits): clamp
            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, vm_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr vm_d7
vm_d4:
            add hl, bc
            ld a, 16

            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, vm_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, vm_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr vm_d6n
vm_d5b:

            sbc hl, bc

            inc e
vm_d6n:

            jr nz, vm_d5

vm_d7:

            ret z

            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret

            ld (vm_ub), bc
            ld d, e                 ; a low x b low
            ld e, c

            ld (vm_lo), de

            ld d, a
            ld a, (vm_ub + 1)

vm_zm2:

            ld (vm_hi), de

            ld d, a
            ld e, b
vm_zm3:

            ex de, hl

            ld d, a
            ld e, c
vm_zm4:
            db #ED, #30
            add hl, de              ; the middle: 17 bits (A = its top bit)
            ld a, 0
            adc a, a
            ld b, a
            ld de, (vm_lo)

            ld d, a
            ld a, h

            adc a, h
            ld h, a
            ex de, hl               ; DE = the high word, HL = the low
            ret

vm_ub:      dw 0

            rl e
            rl d
            add hl, hl
            rl e
            rl d

            ld e, a
            ld d, a
            ld a, 7

            rl d
            dec a

            jr nz, vm_cneg

            or a

            pop hl
            ret c
            ex de, hl
            ret

            push hl
            add hl, de
            pop hl
            ret c
            ld hl, -12000
            ret

vm_acc:     dw 0
vm_sg:      db 0
vm_n:       db 0
